scope: Artificial text and typed scalar fixtures only; no inference or research SQL
rules: Only a plain ASCII signed integer, with surrounding whitespace permitted, is automatically matched
Prose, conflicting numbers, lists, math expressions, decimal text and markdown remain UNCERTAIN for review
Failed or interrupted trajectories are not promoted by a retained late answer
All four planned condition slots must remain, with one independent task pair
No human judgments, C-type intent labels, p-values or confidence intervals are manufactured
integration_limit: Pure scorer assumes upstream verification of full sealed experiment, reference provenance and replayed trace. It is not itself that verification.
